name: Monte Marina Naturist Resort
tagline: Wild Atlantic naturism on the Canary Islands
location: Esquinzo, Jandia Peninsula, Fuerteventura (55 min from Fuerteventura airport)
best_for: Naturists and couples drawn to dramatic landscapes, warm winters, and reliable sunshine

contact.address: Esquinzo, Pájara, Fuerteventura, Canary Islands, Spain

description: Perched above the dramatic wild coast of Fuerteventura's Jandia Peninsula, Monte Marina offers naturist accommodation in one of Europe's most spectacular settings. The resort — managed by the German Duffner family — commands volcanic cliffs above a beautiful naturist beach, with a pool, restaurant, and access to miles of Atlantic wilderness. Year-round warmth (average 24°C) makes it a popular winter destination for European naturists.
highlights: Spectacular volcanic landscape on Fuerteventura's wild south coast
Year-round sunshine — average 24°C, ideal for winter naturist escapes
Beautiful naturist beach below the resort cliffs
Managed by the Duffner family — dedicated naturists and attentive hosts
Excellent pool and sun terrace with panoramic Atlantic views
Walking access to miles of dramatic unspoiled coastline
considerations: Remote location — a rental car is essential for exploring
Naturist enforcement varies; some guests have encountered non-naturist behaviour
WiFi is paid extra and speed is variable

reviews.name: NaturistDuo
reviews.text: Monte Marina is a truly relaxing paradise on the wild, unspoilt southern coast of Fuerteventura. The setting is spectacular — dramatic volcanic cliffs meeting turquoise Atlantic waters. The resort itself is beautifully maintained with excellent pool facilities and a lovely naturist beach. Staff were warm, helpful, and professional throughout. Food at the restaurant was above average for a resort. We loved the tranquility — far from the tourist strip of the north. Our best naturist holiday in years.

reviews.name: EuropeanNaturist
reviews.text: After visiting naturist resorts across Europe for fifteen years, Monte Marina stands out as one of the very best. The combination of stunning natural scenery, an excellent pool, a beautiful naturist beach, and genuinely friendly management is hard to match. The Duffner family who run the resort are dedicated naturists themselves — it shows in every detail. Food at the restaurant is excellent. The surrounding wilderness is perfect for long walks. Already booked for next year.

reviews.name: GunnarS
reviews.text: High quality in every sense — the accommodation is spotlessly clean and well-equipped, the pool area is outstanding with generous lounger availability, and the beach below is wild and beautiful. Staff were unfailingly helpful throughout our two-week stay. The restaurant offers a good menu at fair prices. WiFi is available at an extra charge and works adequately. The resort attracts a loyal, regular European clientele who appreciate the high standards maintained here. Would unhesitatingly recommend.

reviews.name: SunnySideUp
reviews.text: It really is as simple as the title suggests: Hotel — well-maintained, clean, good amenities. Sun — Fuerteventura delivers guaranteed year-round sunshine. Naked — fully naturist resort where naturism is genuinely respected and practiced. Perfect — the combination adds up to a holiday that genuinely restores you. The pool area is excellent, the beach is spectacular in its wildness, and the staff are friendly. We have been coming for six years and have no intention of stopping.

reviews.name: CommittedNaturist
reviews.text: We chose Monte Marina specifically for a fully naturist experience and were frustrated to find that many guests — particularly day visitors — were wearing swimwear around the pool and on the beach. When we raised this with reception, we were told they cannot force guests to undress. This undermines the whole point of a naturist resort. The facilities and setting are genuinely beautiful. But if you are a committed naturist expecting proper enforcement, be aware that the reality may disappoint.

reviews.name: NaturistPurist
reviews.text: Despite the name, Monte Marina is not a genuine naturist resort in practice. Non-naturist guests are accommodated without question and swimwear is common around the pool. Management appears to have adopted a laissez-faire attitude that allows this to continue unchallenged. We spoke with several other naturist guests who shared our deep frustration. The location and landscape are undeniably beautiful and the facilities are adequate — but calling this a naturist resort is genuinely misleading.
